verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration platform, not an agent, so this server-side axis applies. Its first-party docs describe hosted 'Magic MCP' endpoints that expose provider tools through one connection, and sessions that return a `connection_url` for any MCP client. Portal users can also copy a standard MCP URL into clients such as Cursor, ChatGPT and Claude, and admins can inspect which agent clients connected. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that an agent actually connects to the hosted MCP endpoint (the probes only hit llms.txt, the docs mirror and the REST API), and any evidence of an MCP server exposing Metorial's own platform management rather than just integration tools.
